lastCompletedStory.title: Reconcile implementer agent SYSTEM PROMPT to the injected-story model

nextStoryContext: US-001 reconciled the subagent-implementer.md SYSTEM PROMPT (both .claude and templates copies) to the injected-story model already shipped in decide.ts/task-prompt.ts (CAM-224, US-001): the frontmatter description, the 'Inputs you will read' point 1, the 'Inputs read order' jq self-selection block, and the Operator-required-stories 'Selection logic' sentence now all state that the story is provided in the spawn prompt (id/title/description/priority/requires/acceptanceCriteria/branchName) and that the worker still reads prd.json only to fetch the story's notes field and to flip passes:true. Per-copy divergences noted in prior story notes (handoff.json Read-tool mandatory note, quality-gate step detail, vendor-drift output line) were left untouched since they are out of this story's scope. Remember to run `bun run embed-vendor` after any further templates/ edit before `embed-vendor:check` will pass.
